name: MYCL proto-oncogene, bHLH transcription factor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MYCL encodes protein L-Myc. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and protein dimerization activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Small cell lung carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
